Label: Target: 30+ DPD in 12 Months
Description: Binary target variable: 1 if the account reached 30+ days past due at any point within the first 12 months of origination, 0 otherwise.

Label: Target: 60+ DPD in 12 Months
Description: Binary target variable: 1 if the account reached 60+ days past due within 12 months of origination.

Label: Target: 90+ DPD in 24 Months
Description: Binary target variable: 1 if the account reached 90+ days past due within 24 months. Common definition of 'bad' for credit scorecard development.

Label: Target: Charge-off in 24 Months
Description: Binary target variable: 1 if the account was charged off within 24 months of origination.

Label: Worst Delinquency Status 12 Months
Description: Worst delinquency bucket reached in the first 12 months. 0=Current, 1=30DPD, 2=60DPD, 3=90DPD, 4=120DPD, 5=150+DPD, 6=Charge-off.
Special Values: 0=Current; 1=30 DPD; 2=60 DPD; 3=90 DPD; 4=120 DPD; 5=150+ DPD; 6=Charge-off/Write-off; -1=Immature; -7=Not Available

Label: Months on Book
Description: Number of months since account origination/booking.

Label: Current Outstanding Balance
Description: Current outstanding principal balance on the account.

Label: Number of Payments Made
Description: Total count of payments received since origination.

Label: Number of Missed Payments
Description: Total count of missed or late payments since origination.

Label: Net Loss Amount
Description: Net dollar loss on the account after recoveries (only populated for charged-off accounts).
Special Values: 0=No Loss / Active Account; -1=Not Yet Resolved; -7=Not Available

Label: Account Status
Special Values: 1=Current/Open; 2=30 DPD; 3=60 DPD; 4=90 DPD; 5=120+ DPD; 6=Charge-off; 7=Paid in Full; 8=Closed by Customer; -7=Not Available

Label: Origination Date
Description: Date the account was originated/booked, stored as YYYYMMDD integer.

Label: Contract Interest Rate
Description: Annual interest rate on the account at origination, expressed as a percentage.
